"""V2 adversarial mutant runner for HS-00.02 (isolated mktemp copy only).

Copies the four product/test files into a fresh temp dir, applies one textual
mutation per case, runs the frozen RED test file against the copy, and records
command / times / exit code / full output / diffs / sha256 in v2-mutants.json.
The product worktree is never written.
"""

import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = ROOT / "humansearch" / ".venv" / "bin" / "python"
HELPER = "scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
MUT_SH = "scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh"
TEST = "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py"
COPY_FILES = [HELPER, MUT_SH, TEST, "humansearch/pyproject.toml"]

SUFFIX_BLOCK = (
    "        elif message.startswith(expected):\n"
    "            suffix = message[len(expected):]\n"
    '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n'
    "                return True\n"
)
GUARD = '    if not expected or "\\n" in expected or "\\r" in expected:\n        return False\n'
FAIL_FILTER = '        if not line.startswith("FAIL: "):\n            continue\n'
LEGACY_IF = "            if re.fullmatch(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message):\n"
SH_CALL = '  elif ! python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" "$expect"; then\n'

# (name, file, old, new, expectation) expectation: "pass" for normal, "fail" for mutants that tests must catch
MUTANTS = [
    ("m00-normal", HELPER, "", "", "pass"),
    ("m01-always-allow", HELPER, GUARD, "    return True\n" + GUARD, "fail"),
    ("m02-always-reject", HELPER, GUARD, "    return False\n" + GUARD, "fail"),
    ("m03-regex-restore", HELPER, SUFFIX_BLOCK,
     "        elif re.search(expected, message):\n            return True\n", "fail"),
    ("m04-omit-fail-line-filter", HELPER, FAIL_FILTER, "", "fail"),
    ("m05-omit-boundary", HELPER, SUFFIX_BLOCK,
     "        elif message.startswith(expected):\n            return True\n", "fail"),
    ("m06-restore-old-grep", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! /usr/bin/grep -q -- "$expect" "$TMP/out.log"; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m07-accept-empty-expected", HELPER, GUARD,
     '    if "\\n" in expected or "\\r" in expected:\n        return False\n', "fail"),
    ("m08-legacy-substring", HELPER, LEGACY_IF, "            if expected in message:\n", "fail"),
    ("m09-legacy-match-unanchored-end", HELPER, LEGACY_IF,
     "            if re.match(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message):\n", "fail"),
    ("m10-legacy-search", HELPER, LEGACY_IF,
     "            if re.search(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message):\n", "fail"),
    ("m11-boundary-any-non-alnum", HELPER, '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n',
     "            if not suffix or not suffix[0].isalnum():\n", "fail"),
    ("m12-substring-anywhere-with-boundary", HELPER, SUFFIX_BLOCK,
     "        elif (idx := message.find(expected)) >= 0:\n"
     "            suffix = message[idx + len(expected):]\n"
     '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n'
     "                return True\n", "fail"),
    ("m13-legacy-target-wildcard", HELPER,
     'TARGET = r"(?:PR #[0-9]+|task/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+)"\n', 'TARGET = r".*"\n', "fail"),
    ("m14-drop-slash-boundary", HELPER, '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n',
     '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t":\n', "fail"),
    ("m15-drop-newline-guard", HELPER, GUARD, "    if not expected:\n        return False\n", "fail"),
    ("m16-unreadable-file-exit0", HELPER,
     '        print(f"cannot read kickoff output: {error}", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n',
     '        print(f"cannot read kickoff output: {error}", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 0\n', "fail"),
    ("m17-shell-inverted", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" "$expect"; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m18-shell-args-swapped", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$expect" "$TMP/out.log"; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m19-shell-unquoted-expect", MUT_SH, SH_CALL,
     '  elif ! python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" $expect; then\n', "fail"),
    ("m20-exact-full-line-only", HELPER, '            if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":\n',
     "            if not suffix:\n", "fail"),
    ("m21-pass-lines-also-count", HELPER, FAIL_FILTER,
     '        if not line.startswith(("FAIL: ", "PASS: ")):\n            continue\n', "fail"),
    ("m22-no-prefix-strip", HELPER,
     '        message = line.removeprefix("FAIL: ").removesuffix("\\r")\n',
     '        message = line.removesuffix("\\r")\n', "fail"),
    ("m23-legacy-table-emptied", HELPER, "LEGACY_REASONS = {\n", "LEGACY_REASONS: dict[str, str] = {}\n_UNUSED = {\n", "fail"),
    ("m24-legacy-count-allow-zero", HELPER, "[1-9][0-9]*개가", "[0-9]+개가", "fail"),
]


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def clean_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in {"BASH_ENV", "ENV"}}


def run_case(iso: Path, name: str, rel: str, old: str, new: str, expectation: str) -> dict:
    originals = {f: (ROOT / f).read_text(encoding="utf-8") for f in (HELPER, MUT_SH)}
    for f, text in originals.items():
        (iso / f).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    mutated = originals[rel] if rel else ""
    applied = 0
    if old:
        applied = originals[rel].count(old)
        assert applied == 1, f"{name}: pattern occurrences = {applied}"
        mutated = originals[rel].replace(old, new)
        (iso / rel).write_text(mutated, encoding="utf-8")
    diff = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(
        originals[rel].splitlines(keepends=True), mutated.splitlines(keepends=True),
        fromfile=f"a/{rel}", tofile=f"b/{rel}")) if old else ""
    (ART / f"v2-mutant-{name}.diff").write_text(diff, encoding="utf-8")
    cmd = [str(PY), "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--rootdir", str(iso / "humansearch"),
           str(iso / TEST)]
    start = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=iso, env=clean_env(), text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    end = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    out = proc.stdout + ("\n--- stderr ---\n" + proc.stderr if proc.stderr else "")
    (ART / f"v2-mutant-{name}.log").write_text(out, encoding="utf-8")
    summary = [line for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if " passed" in line or " failed" in line or "error" in line.lower()]
    killed = proc.returncode != 0
    status = ("PASS" if proc.returncode == 0 else "FAIL-UNEXPECTED") if expectation == "pass" else ("KILLED" if killed else "SURVIVED")
    return {
        "name": name, "file": rel, "expectation": expectation, "status": status,
        "pattern_occurrences": applied, "command": cmd, "cwd": str(iso), "start": start, "end": end,
        "exit_code": proc.returncode, "summary": summary[-1] if summary else "",
        "mutated_sha256": hashlib.sha256(mutated.encode()).hexdigest() if old else sha(iso / HELPER),
        "diff_file": f"v2-mutant-{name}.diff", "log_file": f"v2-mutant-{name}.log",
    }


def main() -> int:
    before = {f: sha(ROOT / f) for f in (HELPER, MUT_SH, TEST)}
    iso = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hs0002-v2-"))
    for f in COPY_FILES:
        (iso / f).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / f, iso / f)
    results = []
    only = set(sys.argv[1:])
    for name, rel, old, new, expectation in MUTANTS:
        if only and name not in only:
            continue
        r = run_case(iso, name, rel, old, new, expectation)
        print(f"{r['status']:16} {name:40} exit={r['exit_code']} {r['summary']}")
        results.append(r)
    after = {f: sha(ROOT / f) for f in (HELPER, MUT_SH, TEST)}
    report = {
        "head": subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True).stdout.strip(),
        "isolated_copy": str(iso), "product_sha256_before": before, "product_sha256_after": after,
        "product_unchanged": before == after, "results": results,
        "survived": [r["name"] for r in results if r["status"] == "SURVIVED"],
        "unexpected": [r["name"] for r in results if r["status"] == "FAIL-UNEXPECTED"],
    }
    (ART / "v2-mutants.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    shutil.rmtree(iso, ignore_errors=True)
    print("product_unchanged:", before == after, "survived:", report["survived"], "unexpected:", report["unexpected"])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
